messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated token latency on /v1/generate (text-gen-v2) detected at 2026-03-15T12:00:34Z. Paging @maria, @liam.

maria: saw it. tail latency jumping. p95 -> 1.6s, p99 -> 6s, error ratio creeping up to 2.3%.

liam: I'm on it. collecting runtime metrics.

alex: any customer-facing impact? support-bot?

support-bot: ticket INC-4219 opened for customer "NimbusMaps" reporting slow responses, degraded UX. Notified CSM.

maria: ok, quick assessment: backend queues on gpu-pool-2 are piling. inflight hits 520/600 but headroom reduced due to long seqs. KV cache hit rate dropped to 12%.

jess: is autoscaler mis-behaving? are pods OOMing or just queuing?

liam: no OOMs. GPU util ~92% on some nodes, scheduler latency high. suspect our continuous-batching config overbatches long seqs. Putting mitigations on the table:
- reduce max_inflight per-worker from 600 -> 200
- enable soft-shedding on low-priority routes (embeds/async)
- raise per-key token-rate limit from 50/s -> 20/s for free-tier
- temporarily disable long-context feature flag `llm-long-context` for hosted tier

maria: priority order: 1) quick rate-limit bump for free-tier, 2) reduce max_inflight, 3) soft-shed non-critical routes. Disabling feature is last resort.

liam: I'll push the rate-limit change now: `rbxctl config set rate_limit.free_tier 20` deploying.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config/rate-limit at 2478901247 by liam.

maria: meanwhile I'll prepare a runtime change. Oncall playbook: to change max_inflight on pool gpu-pool-2 run:
```
kubectl -n runtime patch cm serving-config --type merge -p '{"max_inflight":200,"pool":"gpu-pool-2"}'
``` 
I'll apply after rate-limit confirms.

liam: deploy succeeded. Observability: token qps on free-tier dropped ~60% in 30s.

support-bot: update: NimbusMaps reporting fewer timeouts but slower responses still.

maria: applying max_inflight now.

deploy-bot: config patch applied at 2478901289 by maria.

alex: are we going to see increased tail due to queuing? reducing max_inflight should reduce latency for served requests but may cause more shedding.

maria: yes expected shed on in-flight requests >200. that's acceptable short-term. Enabling soft-shed rule for route `/v1/embeddings` now.

liam: applied soft-shed rule: `traffic-shaper --pool gpu-pool-2 --route /v1/embeddings --policy soft-shed --threshold 0.8`

jess: adding timeout tuning: lower backend token timeout from 30s -> 10s for background routes to free resources quicker.

maria: pushed timeout change. Also starting to monitor fallback model routing; if text-gen-v2 saturates we'll route to text-gen-v1 (cheaper) for low-priority calls.

liam: routing policy updated: route-match low_priority -> text-gen-v1. Implemented.

support-bot: NimbusMaps confirms page of improvement. SLA errors down to 0.6%.

maria: good. watch metrics for 15m. If error ratio drops below 0.5% and p99 < 2s, we'll roll back rate-limit change.

liam: metrics are trending well. p95 back to 0.9s, p99 ~ 2.3s.

alex: long-term action items: revisit batching config to respect seq-length distribution, add dynamic kv cache warming, and refine max_inflight per pool based on GPU type.

maria: I'll own a follow-up with runtime-ml to benchmark batching thresholds. create ticket RINF-876.

jess: also document the soft-shed playbook in runbooks/mitigations.

maria: thanks all. I'll keep thread pinned for 30m.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — mitigations in place. Monitoring for 30m. Closed page at 2478901359.
